AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JANUARY 18, 2024 AT 10:00 AM

  1.  REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 10:00 AM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the January 18, 2024
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on
  January 11, 2024 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

  2.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
   Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the December 21, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Lessa Pelayo-Lozada, Assistant Director of Library, Arts & Culture
  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

 5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Selection of a Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2024.
  b. Selection of a Vice Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2024.
  c. Selection and Appointment of Commission Members to Artist Review and
  Selection Committees.
  1. Motion appointing two Commission Members to serve a one-year term on the Artist
  Review and Selection Committee for the Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station &
  Storefront Art Program, Beyond the Box – Utility Box Mural Art Program and the Brand
  Summer Music Series & Jewel City Concert Series.
  2. Motion appointing one Commission Member to serve a one-year term on the Artist
  Review and Selection Committee for the City-Wide Public Art: Request for Qualifications
  and Creative Crosswalks Program.
  d. Commission of Artwork – Shepard Fairey | Obey Giant Art, Inc.
  1. Motion approving the Director of Community Services & Parks / Interim Director of
  Library, Arts & Culture, or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of
  Artwork with Shepard Fairey | Obey Giant Art, Inc. to design a mural rendering for the
  City of Glendale, in an amount not to exceed $14,000 from the 2023-2024 Work Plan.
  e. 2024 Strategic Communications Plan – The ACE Agency
  Motion to note and file.
  f. Claremont Graduate University – Work Study Program
  Motion approving the funding of a financial stipend for a Graduate student from the
  Claremont Graduate University - Work Study Program from January to December 2024 to
  assist with programmatic initiatives of the Arts and Culture Commission, in an amount not
  to exceed $7,000 from the 2023 - 2024 Work Plan.

6.  DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2023 – 2024 Work Plan Progress

7.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS

9.  ADJOURNMENT
 The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
February 15, 2024, at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway (2nd Floor)
Glendale, CA 91206.
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, January 18, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on January 18, 2024, at 10:01 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Tufenkian, Commissioners Vidor, Yank, Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian,
  Chairperson Viar
  •  Absent: None
  •  The Agenda for the January 18, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on January 11, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

 2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the December 21, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded : Commissioner Yank

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Tufenkian, Vidor, Yank, Zadorian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Lessa Pelayo-Lozada, Assistant Director of Library, Arts & Culture
  • Ms. Pelayo-Lozada introduced herself to the Commission as the new Assistant Director of Library,
  Arts & Culture. The Commission welcomed her to the city.

  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  • Alan Dish, Musician and Public Space Activist thanked the Commission for the public pianos
  installed within the city and briefly spoke about the main central Glendale Library.

  1
 5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Selection of a Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2024.
  • Commissioner Yank nominated Commissioner Vidor.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Tufenkian, Yank, Zadorian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Vidor, Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  b. Selection of a Vice Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2024.
  • Commissioner Viar nominated Commissioner Yank

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Tufenkian, Commissioners Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Yank, Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  c. Selection and Appointment of Commission Members to Artist Review and
  Selection Committees.
  1. Motion appointing two Commission Members to serve a one-year term on the Artist
  Review and Selection Committee for the Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station &
  Storefront Art Program, Beyond the Box – Utility Box Mural Art Program and the Brand
  Summer Music Series & Jewel City Concert Series.

That regarding the Report to the Commission, dated January 18, 2024, about selecting and appointing
Commission Members to the Artist Review and Selection Committees, the Commission hereby
appoints two Commissioners to serve on the Artist Review and Selection Committee, for a one-year
term, for each of the following Arts and Culture Commission programs and projects:

  1.  Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station & Storefront Art Program:
  o  Commissioner Tufenkian, Zadorian, Student Commissioner Aleksandryan
  2.  Beyond the Box - Utility Box Mural Art Program:
  o  Chairperson Vidor, Vice Chair Yank
  3.  Brand Summer Music Series & 222 East Concert Series:
  o  Commissioner Viar, Chairperson Vidor, Student Commissioner Pogosian
  Moved:  Vice Chair Yank
  Seconded : Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  2
   2. Motion appointing one Commission Member to serve a one-year term on the Artist
  Review and Selection Committee for the City-Wide Public Art: Request for Qualifications
  and Creative Crosswalks Program.

That regarding the Report to the Commission, dated January 18, 2024, about selecting and appointing
Commission Members to the Artist Review and Selection Committees, the Commission hereby
appoints one Commissioner to serve on the Artist Review and Selection Committee, for a one-year
term, for each of the following Arts and Culture Commission programs and projects:

  1.  City-Wide Public Art: Request for Qualifications:
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian
  2.  Creative Crosswalks Program:
  •  Commissioner Zadorian
  Moved:  Vice Chair Yank
  Seconded : Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Tufenkian, Vidor, Yank, Zadorian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  d. Commission of Artwork – Shepard Fairey | Obey Giant Art, Inc.
  1. Motion approving the Director of Community Services & Parks / Interim Director of
  Library, Arts & Culture, or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of
  Artwork with Shepard Fairey | Obey Giant Art, Inc. to design a mural rendering for the
  City of Glendale, in an amount not to exceed $14,000 from the 2023-2024 Work Plan.

That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the Director of Community Services & Parks /
Interim Director of Library, Arts & Culture, or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of
Artwork with Shepard Fairey | Obey Giant Art, Inc. to design a mural rendering for the City of Glendale,
in an amount not to exceed $14,000 dispersed from the 2023-2024 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in
the January 18, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a summary of the Staff report of next steps to develop a
  mural rendering. The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded : Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  3
   e. 2024 Strategic Communications Plan – The ACE Agency
  1. Motion to note and file.

That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves notes and files the 2024 Strategic
Communications Plan presented by The ACE Agency, as more fully outlined in the January 18, 2024
Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  •  Ashley Patterson of the Ace Agency gave the Commission a brief presentation of the
  Communications Plan. The Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded : Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Viar, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  f. Claremont Graduate University – Work Study Program
  1. Motion approving the funding of a financial stipend for a Graduate student from the
  Claremont Graduate University - Work Study Program from January to December 2024 to
  assist with programmatic initiatives of the Arts and Culture Commission, in an amount not
  to exceed $7,000 from the 2023 - 2024 Work Plan.

That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the funding of a financial stipend for a
Graduate student from the Claremont Graduate University – Arts Administration Work Study Program
from January to December 2024 to assist with programmatic initiatives of the Arts and Culture
Commission, in an amount not to exceed $7,000 from the 2023 - 2024 Month Work Plan, as more fully
outlined in the January 18, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
Administrator.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief report of the funding of a financial stipend for a Graduate
  student of Claremont Graduate University.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded : Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

6. DISCUSSION ITEMS
a. 2023 – 2024 Work Plan Progress

  a. CITY WIDE ARTS
  i.  Mural Ordinance
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that Staff is working on the final draft of a Mural Ordinance The
  final draft Mural Ordinance will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an
  upcoming Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  4
   ii.  Creative Crosswalks: La Crescenta Rehabilitation Project – Update:
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that Library, Arts & Culture Staff have been working with
  Public Works staff to incorporate five Creative Crosswalks to be located at four
  intersections as part of the La Crescenta Rehabilitation Project. Staff shared the proposed
  designs.

b. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No update
c. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update.
d. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No update.

e. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – No update.

7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Commission welcomed Commissioner Vidor as the new Chairperson and thanked
  Commissioner Viar and Tufenkian with their work with the Commission as Chairperson
  and Vice Chairperson to the Commission.
  • Chairperson Vidor adjourned the meeting in honor and memory of Community member
  Barbara Don.

8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None

9. ADJOURNMENT 10:57 a.m.

The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, February 15, 2024, at
10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway (2 Floor) Glendale, CA 91206.
